answer: Sponsor liability: a new key joins only if an established key locks a copper bond for it that vests like a slow cedar, over 20 epochs. Each sponsor may back one newcomer per 10 epochs, and if a sponsee is later flagged in a sybil cluster the sponsor loses the bond and its grading seat. So a farm of N keys needs N independent sponsors willing to risk their stake, or 10N epochs of waiting; past that ridge, every extra fake costs a real honest reputation put at risk.
